subject: Upcoming Travel Itinerary Confirmation
body: Dear [Recipient], We are excited to confirm your upcoming travel itinerary from New York to London. Your flight is scheduled for September 15th at 8:00 AM. Please arrive at the airport at least two hours prior to departure. Your hotel reservation at The Park Lane Hotel is also confirmed. We hope you have a pleasant journey and a wonderful stay in London. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us. Safe travels! Best regards, Travel Agency
